plain: Made new again; started up again after a break

webster.text: Made new again; repaired; re-established; repeated; revived; renovated; regenerated.

example.quote: In New-Hampshire, the attack was made on the legislature, but the insurrection was in a very few hours suppressed, and has never been renewed.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
